meta.name: ginkgo-cloud-lab
meta.description: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Bioworks Cloud Lab (cloud.ginkgo.bio), a web-based interface for autonomous lab execution on Reconfigurable Automation Carts (RACs). Use when the user wants to run protein expression and purification (cell-free, E. coli, or Pichia), HiBiT or A280 or LabChip quantification, IVT mRNA/circRNA synthesis, thermal shift / developability assays, Echo-MS enzyme or analyte methods, SPR target onboarding, fluorescent pixel art, or otherwise interact with Ginkgo Cloud Lab services. Covers protocol selection, input preparation, pricing, and ordering workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 上提交和管理实验方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在云端自动化实验室运行生物实验流程。
copy.tagline_en: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Cloud Lab
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run automated lab experiments on a cloud platform.

howto.what: 它帮你从 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 的实验方案目录里挑合适的方案,准备输入文件(如 FASTA/CSV/XLSX),走完下单报价流程;也能用 EstiMate 描述自定义实验,获取可行性与价格评估。
howto.when: 当你想做蛋白质表达与纯化、HiBiT/A280/LabChip 定量、IVT mRNA/circRNA 合成等实验,或用 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 的其他服务时触发。

say.text: 我想表达并纯化一个蛋白,用 cell-free 方案,帮我选协议并下单。
say.note: 它会挑选对应协议并指导填写参数与下单。

say.text: 用 EstiMate 估一下我这个自定义实验的可行性和价格。
say.note: 它会引导你到 EstiMate 提交描述并获取评估。

say.text: 帮我准备 IVT mRNA 合成的输入模板,我要提交 3 个样品。
say.note: 它会给出模板填写与上传步骤。

howto.what_en: Helps you pick a protocol from the Ginkgo Cloud Lab catalog, prepare input files (e.g., FASTA/CSV/XLSX), and handle ordering and pricing; can also use EstiMate to describe custom experiments and get feasibility and price estimates.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want protein expression and purification, HiBiT/A280/LabChip quantification, IVT mRNA/circRNA synthesis, or other Ginkgo Cloud Lab services (thermal shift, Echo-MS, SPR).

say_en.text: Express and purify a protein via cell-free; pick a protocol and order it.
say_en.note: It selects the matching protocol and guides ordering steps.

say_en.text: Use EstiMate to estimate feasibility and price for this custom experiment.
say_en.note: Routes the request to EstiMate for feasibility and pricing.

say_en.text: Help prepare the input template for IVT mRNA synthesis; I need 3 samples.
say_en.note: It explains how to fill in and upload the template.
